assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 environmental illustration for the fantasy courier game The Silent Route. Simpul Sembilan, an ancient Warjian relay ruin on a high desert escarpment during a sandstorm. A tall weathered moss-grey monolith with fractured circular bronze rings, subtle abstract non-linguistic ancient grooves, a small golden lantern-like crystal on an open stone altar at its base. Horizontal terracotta sand sweeps across the foreground under a heavy slate-grey sky, layered silhouettes of remote ruined relay towers disappear into dust. In the lower third a tiny young androgynous courier wearing a cream sail-cape, terracotta scarf and leather mailbag climbs a marked rocky ledge using a taut rope anchored in a golden ring; cape blows sideways. Companion a tiny fennec with a warm lantern tail waits on the ledge. Fine sepia ink outlines, sparse cross-hatching, broad flat gouache shapes, atmospheric paper texture and subtle airbrush, Moebius sense of vast quiet scale, Ghibli emotional warmth only in lantern accents. Restrained palette #4A4A57 #34343F #8A5A45 #C79A6B #6F7A68 with small yellow #F2C46B focal glow. Threatening weather but nonviolent, adventurous. No weapons, no combat, no futuristic machines, no words, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no photorealism, no glossy 3D, no closeup character.
assets.intent: Original world illustration for Simpul Sembilan chapter and world atlas.
assets.review: Inspected generated output: Warjian relay ruin, slate storm, sand, courier using rope, Ruru and golden crystal present; no text.
